_comment: Pinned environment for the first identity reconstruction. Every value here is something that must be reproducible, or that we will want to compare against if a second run behaves differently.

target.why_pinned: A moving main branch makes a failed run impossible to distinguish from an upstream change. setup.sh checks out this exact commit.

model.name: LHMPP-700M-SMPLX-FREE
model.why_this_one: Exports standard 3DGS PLY, is listed in GS_RENDER_SUPPORTED_MODEL_NAMES, and may avoid the licence-gated SMPL-X asset. PixelShuffle is the newer default but its hub weights are marked pending, so it is not a candidate for a first run.

not_using.LHM-1B-HF: previous plan; kept as fallback only

environment_policy.principle: Run the repository's DOCUMENTED stack. This box is disposable precisely so the old research stack can run natively.
environment_policy.modernise_only_if: something actually breaks, or the GPU cannot run it

gpu_selection.avoid_reason: torch 2.3.0+cu121 contains no sm_120 kernels. Choosing a Blackwell box recreates exactly the compatibility problem this remote plan exists to escape, and would force modernising a stack we deliberately want to run as documented.
gpu_selection.do_not_rent: 80 GB cards. This is inference, not training.

run.pose_dir_note: Deliberately empty. Omitting --pose_dir gives canonical T-pose Gaussians via inference_gs with a synthetic camera, which is stage A+B only. Supplying a SMPL-X JSON is animation (stage C) and is not part of the identity gate.

open_question_to_resolve_on_the_box.question: Does the SMPLX-FREE checkpoint complete a single-image -> canonical PLY export WITHOUT the gated MPI human_model_files?
open_question_to_resolve_on_the_box.why_it_matters: If yes, the SMPL-X registration and download can be postponed until animation integration, and may never be needed for the identity gate at all.
open_question_to_resolve_on_the_box.how_verify_environment.py_answers_it: It reports whether human_model_files exists and whether SMPL-X files were found, and run_lhmpp.sh does NOT fetch them - so a successful export with 'none found' is the answer.
open_question_to_resolve_on_the_box.do_not: Assume the model name settles this. The repository's motion/any-pose paths still reference SMPL-X JSON and human_model_files.
